description: Unit test class ClaimDaoAttachmentTest for testing the ClaimDao methods related to claim attachment management, including CRUD operations and file retrieval, within the OrangeHRM claim plugin.

classes.name: ClaimDaoAttachmentTest
classes.description: Test class for ClaimDao's claim attachment related methods, utilizing mock data and various assertions.

methods.name: testGetPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a partial claim attachment by attachment ID and request ID, asserting expected ID and filename.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentCount
methods.description: Tests counting of claim attachments based on search filter parameters, asserting expected count.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentList
methods.description: Tests listing of claim attachments with specific filter, asserting count and filename of the first item.

methods.name: testGetNextAttachmentId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of next available attachment ID, asserting expected sequential ID.

methods.name: testSaveClaimAttachment
methods.description: Tests saving a new claim attachment, then verifies its existence and properties.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimAttachments
methods.description: Tests deletion of claim attachments based on a list of IDs and verifies they are removed.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including instantiating ClaimDao and populating test data from YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentFile
methods.description: Tests retrieval of claim attachment file details, including description, filename, and content, and verifies null response for non-existent ID.
